description: Phase 0 baseline for Wave AI (AI.0). Populated 2026-05-25 from the Cloudflare AI Gateway dashboard summary card (last-30-day window, Apr 28 → May 25). Per-route, latency, and Workers AI neuron numbers still require a deeper drill-down (Gateway → Logs filter by metadata.route, plus Workers AI → Usage); recorded as nulls with a clear _todo until that pull happens.
captured_by: AI.0 — first real pull (dashboard summary card)

providers._note: Remaining ~107 requests routed via other providers shown in the dashboard breakdown (Workers AI, etc.) — not split out on the summary card.

daily_usd_by_route_model._todo: Cloudflare Gateway dashboard no longer exposes per-route facets. Run `pnpm ai:baseline:pull` (needs CF_ACCOUNT_ID + CF_API_TOKEN env) — it queries our own `llm_costs` AE dataset via the AE SQL API and writes the split back here. Manual SQL: SELECT blob4 AS endpoint, blob1 AS model, SUM(double4 * _sample_interval) AS usd_total FROM llm_costs WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '30' DAY GROUP BY endpoint, model ORDER BY 3 DESC FORMAT JSON
daily_usd_by_route_model._note: Total spend is trivial ($1.21 / 30d = $0.04/day). Per-route drill-down is still worth doing once so AI.3 tiered-routing has a real before/after, but it's not gating any decision today.

tokens._note: Avg blends prompt + completion across all routes; per-route breakdown deferred with the cost drill-down above.

hit_ratio_by_route._todo: Run `pnpm ai:baseline:pull` — populates from the same `llm_costs` AE query (groups by blob4=endpoint, counts blob3='HIT' vs total). Capture again at the close of the AI.1 7-day window (~2026-06-01).

gateway_cache._baseline_note: 5 / 1070 = 0.47% overall hit ratio across the full 30d window. Expected to be near-zero — `cf-aig-cache-ttl` only shipped on 2026-05-25 (AI.1 commit b3b8234). The AI.1 gate (≥30% hit ratio on `/api/llm` over a fresh 7-day window) is measured against the post-deploy period, not this baseline.

latency_ms._todo: Cloudflare Gateway dashboard no longer exposes per-route latency facets. Run `pnpm ai:baseline:pull` — queries `worker_tail` AE dataset using the same quantileWeighted pattern as functions/api/admin/live-ops.ts. Manual SQL: SELECT blob2 AS path, quantileWeighted(0.50, double3, _sample_interval) AS p50_ms, quantileWeighted(0.95, double3, _sample_interval) AS p95_ms, quantileWeighted(0.99, double3, _sample_interval) AS p99_ms FROM worker_tail WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND blob4 != 'exception' AND blob2 IN ('/api/llm','/api/llm-stream','/api/v2/game/answer','/api/admin/questions/duplicates') GROUP BY path FORMAT JSON

@cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5._note: Text Embeddings panel — sole consumer during the baseline window (question-dedup embeddings, B.4). Two ingestion-driven spikes visible around 2026-05-10.

@cf/meta/llama-guard-3-8b._note: AI.6 moderation gate shipped 2026-05-25 — no production traffic in this window. Re-pull next refresh.

workers_ai._note: Workers AI usage is effectively a rounding error: 13.45 neurons / 30d = 0.045% of the 300k-neuron/30d free-tier envelope (10k/day × 30d). AI.3 tiered routing has near-unlimited headroom on Workers AI before the AI.3 cost-model-A overflow-to-gpt-4o-mini kicks in.

error_rate._baseline_note: Gateway summary card reports 0 errors across all 1070 requests in the 30d window. Bespoke retry logic in functions/api/llm.ts did not surface any user-facing 5xx — strong baseline for the AI.2 fallback-chain conversation (no observed outage to fall back from yet).

refresh_log.note: Initial scaffold; metric fields TODO. Populate before AI.1 ships.

cf-aig-cache-ttl shipped on /api/llm (24h), /api/admin/coverage-priority (6h), /api/admin/analytics/insights (6h). gateway_cache.hit_ratio_by_route should populate after the 7-day observation window. Other admin LLM endpoints flagged for follow-on.

First real dashboard pull (summary card). Filled totals (1070 req / 451.92k tokens / $1.21 / 0 errors / 5 cached), derived daily cost ($0.043/d) and overall cache hit ratio (0.47% — expected, AI.1 only just shipped). Per-route cost split, latency percentiles, and Workers AI neurons still TODO — those need facet drill-down in Gateway Analytics + the Workers AI Usage tab; tracked as inline _todo strings. Removed @cf/meta/llama-guard-3-8b from models_not_yet_adopted (AI.6 shipped).

Pivoted per-route cost + latency from Cloudflare Gateway dashboard (which dropped per-route facet drill-down) to `pnpm ai:baseline:pull` — a small script that queries our own `llm_costs` + `worker_tail` AE datasets via the AE SQL API. Same data, no operator clicking. Script is rerunnable; only needs CF_ACCOUNT_ID + CF_API_TOKEN (already in .dev.vars for live-ops).

Workers AI Usage tab pulled (Last 1 month). Total: 13.45 neurons across 2.22k input tokens, 100% Text Embeddings (@cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5, question-dedup B.4). Two ingestion-driven spikes visible around 2026-05-10. 0 neurons today. → 0.45 neurons/day avg, 0.0045% of the 10k/day free-tier quota — Workers AI has near-unlimited headroom for AI.3 tiered routing before the cost-model-A overflow trigger. Llama-Guard (AI.6) shows 0 in this window because it shipped same-day; next refresh will capture its load. Latency percentiles + per-route Gateway split remain TODO.
